bayts.text: The month of Fasting (Ramaḍān) leads to me what puts to shame (all) striving and vigil, and (what is) above the reward of one who keeps vigil, with an Ancient One Who has brought (me) forward.

The blessing of Rabīʿ (al-Awwal) has come to meet me, removing from me the condition of one sold (to the enemies), on behalf of the month of an Everlasting One rich in abodes: what struck (at me) has not made its way toward me.
My Lord has demolished for us my harm — and what an excellent Lord is ours! — and He has led to me what He built for me, and has removed the countless host.
Whoever showed hatred toward me in time has turned toward others than me; and Allah has led security to me, and the toil of my life has come to an end.
The Everlasting, the Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), has come to meet me with what inclines toward no other; and to what is other than my life (goes) obscurity; and whoever hated me has been deprived.
My Lord has taken away (from me) the condition of one sold, in Ramaḍān and in Rabīʿ (al-Awwal); every week grows good for me, and the one who envies me has not been honoured.
No fighter has made his way toward me: Allah fights on my behalf, and He it is Who breaks my condition of one sold; whoever sought my harm has been destroyed.
No one who would afflict me has made his way toward me, and (all my) life I am a worshipper of my Lord; Iblīs does not afflict one who has been made inviolable for the Gardens.
The Lord of the heaven and the earth has honoured me with an honour that has risen high; and what (He) has allotted to me has yielded to me, and my harm has been cut off.
The gifts of my Lord, Possessor of perfection, lead my whole being with beauty; and He Who through me raises the learned has led to me the most blessed of riches.
Shield of my heart against heedlessness, safeguard of my light from setting: (so) has al-Māḥī (Muḥammad), the guarantor, been for me; and to me he has led protections.
I have worshipped my Lord, the Generous, with a worship that does not cease; and to me what I desired (He) has led, and my life He has preserved.
I worship my Lord in the dwellings, and He has been for me with good things (leading) toward the Gardens of (many) dwellings; and He has been for me and has brought (me) forward.
Straying has not made its way toward my heart, and (He) has been for me with limpid water; no infirmity makes its way toward me, and I am not found in regret.
He Who made the heart good for me has honoured my person for the Gardens; and He has led to me, with munificence, glad tidings for those who came before.
The Everlasting, the Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), has protected me; for me He has illumined meaning and word; my life keeps His remembrance; I have been preserved from whoever did wrong.
Allah, the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), has led to me, beyond what was desired, sciences; the wrongdoer has turned toward others than me, and before that he had surrendered.
I have led my ink and the reed-pens to Him Who protected me from blame; and for me the most excellent of words has removed the darkness from me.
I praise the Originator of the heavens and the earth with a praise that has risen high; and for me what He has allotted to me (He) has led, and He has given me the summits.
